## Provenance & Verification Checklist
- [ ] Content is human-authored or native-verified (`native-reviewed` / `linguist-reviewed`)
- [ ] Explicit `license` (`CC-BY-4.0` / `CC0-1.0`), `origin_type`, and `source_citation` populated
- [ ] Zero copyrighted dictionaries, unverified Bible editions, or synthetic TTS audio included
- [ ] `python3 validation/run_checks.py --check all --schemas-dir schemas/` and `pytest -q validation/tests/` passed
- [ ] Commits include `Signed-off-by:` DCO 1.1 trailer
